Coram : R.F. NARIMAN*, NAVIN SINHA, BHUSHAN RAMKRISHNA GAVAI
Motor Vehicle Accident – Claim under – Victim was hit by a bus, consequent to which he died – The Motor Accident Claims Tribunal found that it was a result of rash and negligent driving by the driver of the bus, which was hired by the appellant-Uttar Pradesh State Road Transport between it and the bus owner – The total quantification of compensation by MACT was of Rs. 1.65 lakhs along with 8% interest and only the appellant-Corporation was directed to pay this entire amount and not the insurance Company – The High Court followed the judgment of Rajasthan
Decision Date : 08-06-2020 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2526/2020 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 3 Judges
